title: Ice Wall
subtitle: Test your understanding of Ice Wall — the glacial perimeter, the Three Ocean Gates, the 1959 lockdown, and the realms beyond the boundary.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Ice Wall is the glacial perimeter of this contained world. Before the 1728–1729 reset it was common knowledge, and the Antarctic Treaty of 1959 later locked the southern edge. Seeing that boundary restores spatial orientation and the way toward spiritual sovereignty.

questions.question: What does the glacial perimeter do for this contained realm?

options.label: A
options.text: It sends telluric currents inward, charges the Axis Mundi, and lights the canopy.
options.rationale: Telluric currents run in the organic circuitboard; the perimeter seals the atmosphere and retains the Super-Ocean.

options.label: B
options.text: It seals the localized atmosphere, retains the Super-Ocean waters, and regulates passage.
options.rationale: The primary physical functions of the perimeter are to seal the localized atmospheric environment, retain the waters of the Super-Ocean, and regulate physical access between realms.

options.label: C
options.text: It stands as an isolated continent, stops equatorial currents, and caps a spinning globe.
options.rationale: The perimeter is the enclosure of a contained terrarium, not an isolated continent at the bottom of a spinning globe.

options.label: D
options.text: It blocks radiation from the vacuum, stores orbital debris, and cools the canopy.
options.rationale: Outer space is the post-reset story; the perimeter seals the localized atmospheric environment and retains the Super-Ocean.

questions.hint: Look at the opening account of what the boundary holds in and what it controls.

questions.question: How widely was the perimeter known before the 1728—1729 reset?

options.label: A
options.text: It stayed inside private initiate circles and custodial gatekeeper orders.
options.rationale: Gatekeeping came with the later treaty; before the reset the perimeter was universal common knowledge among cartographers.

options.label: B
options.text: It was universal common knowledge among populations and cartographers.
options.rationale: Prior to the 1728—1729 global reset, the existence of the perimeter was universal common knowledge among human populations and cartographers.

options.label: C
options.text: It survived as legend text beside the Here be Dragons notes.
options.rationale: Here be Dragons marked real outer zones; the perimeter itself was universal common knowledge among human populations and cartographers.

options.label: D
options.text: It was a late finding by Tartarian sailors before the reset.
options.rationale: Great Tartarie already kept active awareness of the perimeter; that awareness was universal common knowledge before the reset.

questions.hint: Think about cartography and everyday navigation before that memory break.

questions.question: What do the Three Ocean Gates provide between this realm and outer systems?

options.label: A
options.text: Breaches in the energetic canopy where civilian aircraft can cross.
options.rationale: The gates are aquatic corridors; they are seafaring passageways carved through the perimeter ice.

options.label: B
options.text: Land portals at Dyatlov Pass, Sedona, and Israel watched from shore.
options.rationale: Those land portals are guarded by Sasquatch and Yeti; the gates are seafaring passageways carved through the perimeter ice.

options.label: C
options.text: Sub-glacial channels that move petrochemical oil between world sectors.
options.rationale: Oil circulates under the ice on its own; the gates are seafaring passageways carved through the perimeter ice.

options.label: D
options.text: Seafaring passageways cut through the ice for aquatic exit and entry.
options.rationale: The Three Ocean Gates are the seafaring passageways carved through the perimeter ice that serve as the sole aquatic exit and entry points.

questions.hint: Think about travel by water through the perimeter ice.

questions.question: What structure arches over the localized plane and meets the glacial edge?

options.label: A
options.text: A physical, semi-solid energetic dome canopy anchored at the outer limits.
options.rationale: The Firmament is the physical, semi-solid energetic dome canopy that arches over the localized plane, anchored at its outer limits by the glacial perimeter.

options.label: B
options.text: A crystalline ceiling underground that traps telluric currents in the grid.
options.rationale: Crystalline networks sit in the organic circuitboard; the upper covering is a physical, semi-solid energetic dome canopy.

options.label: C
options.text: An unattainable visual projection hung above a ball in infinite vacuum.
options.rationale: Visual projections are the post-reset distraction; the canopy is a physical, semi-solid energetic dome.

options.label: D
options.text: A pressure layer made by ocean evaporation along the ice boundary.
options.rationale: The upper covering is not an evaporation layer; it is a physical, semi-solid energetic dome canopy.

questions.hint: Look at the covering described as the upper boundary of this realm.

questions.question: Why did custodial gatekeepers institute the Antarctic Treaty of 1959?

options.label: A
options.text: To open drilling programs for petrochemical oil under the glacial base.
options.rationale: Oil already circulates under the ice; the treaty was written to prohibit independent exploration and field research.

options.label: B
options.text: To promote the south as a desolate, uninhabitable ice desert for tourism.
options.rationale: The desolate ice-desert story is the public narrative; the treaty was written to prohibit independent exploration and civilian travel.

options.label: C
options.text: To train naval crews sailing through the ocean gates beside the Kraken.
options.rationale: Kraken guard the gates against unauthorized vessels; the treaty was written to prohibit independent exploration.

options.label: D
options.text: To prohibit independent exploration, civilian travel, and field research there.
options.rationale: The Antarctic Treaty of 1959 prohibits independent exploration, civilian travel, and field research along the southern perimeter.

questions.hint: Think about public travel toward the southern boundary after a modern discovery.

questions.question: Which engineered beings watch the waters at the ocean portals?

options.label: A
options.text: Sasquatch and Yeti moved from the land nodes to block ships.
options.rationale: Sasquatch and Yeti guard land portals; Kraken and Megalodons watch the ocean portals.

options.label: B
options.text: Genetically engineered Kraken and Megalodons that stop unapproved ships.
options.rationale: Custodial systems engineered Kraken and Megalodons to inhabit the waters at the gates and destroy unauthorized vessels.

options.label: C
options.text: Freemason officers of the 33rd degree who inspect passing ships.
options.rationale: Those initiates carry the public narrative on land; Kraken and Megalodons watch the ocean portals.

options.label: D
options.text: Anakim Giants called in from Hyperborea to challenge passing ships.
options.rationale: Anakim Giants inhabit outer realms; Kraken and Megalodons watch the ocean portals.

questions.hint: Think about the marine defense placed on those passageways.

questions.question: Who watches the land portals at Dyatlov Pass, Sedona, and Israel?

options.label: A
options.text: Anakim Giants running field defense on those inland nodes.
options.rationale: Anakim Giants live beyond the wall; land portals are guarded by biological security entities like Sasquatch and Yeti.

options.label: B
options.text: Genetically engineered Kraken posted at those inland nodes.
options.rationale: Kraken watch the ocean portals; land portals are guarded by biological security entities like Sasquatch and Yeti.

options.label: C
options.text: Biological security entities such as Sasquatch and Yeti.
options.rationale: Land-based portals at Dyatlov Pass, Sedona, and Israel are guarded by biological security entities like Sasquatch and Yeti.

options.label: D
options.text: Vetted military units enforcing the southern treaty line.
options.rationale: Vetted military personnel are permitted at the southern perimeter; land portals are guarded by biological security entities like Sasquatch and Yeti.

questions.hint: Look at the biological security assigned to those nodal places.

questions.question: Why was the spinning-ball story spread after the 1728—1729 reset?

options.label: A
options.text: To help Tartarian navigators reach the outer Lands of Mars.
options.rationale: The story hid outer lands; it was introduced to erase the perimeter from human awareness.

options.label: B
options.text: To erase the perimeter from human awareness and aim curiosity upward.
options.rationale: The heliocentric narrative was introduced following the 1728—1729 reset specifically to erase the perimeter from human awareness and redirect curiosity into unattainable visual projections.

options.label: C
options.text: To standardize latitude math for sailing across the Super-Ocean.
options.rationale: Tartarian navigators already used flat-plane geometry; the new story was spread to erase the perimeter from human awareness.

options.label: D
options.text: To explain why compass needles hold on the central Axis Mundi.
options.rationale: Compass alignment toward the Axis Mundi is concealed by the globe story, which was spread to erase the perimeter from human awareness.

questions.hint: Think about where human curiosity was pointed once the old maps were gone.

questions.question: When did expeditionary forces physically locate the upper canopy?

options.label: A
options.text: During 1729, as the global memory reset closed among navigators.
options.rationale: 1729 belongs to the reset; expeditionary forces physically located the firmament in 1956.

options.label: B
options.text: During 1728, as the global memory reset opened among cartographers.
options.rationale: 1728 marks the reset; expeditionary forces physically located the firmament in 1956.

options.label: C
options.text: During 1956, when expeditionary forces reached that upper canopy.
options.rationale: Expeditionary forces physically located the firmament in 1956, before the Antarctic Treaty of 1959.

options.label: D
options.text: During 1959, in the year the southern legal compact was instituted.
options.rationale: 1959 is the treaty year; expeditionary forces physically located the firmament in 1956.

questions.hint: Look at the mid-century finding that came before the southern legal lockdown.

questions.question: How do the Lands of Mars meet this localized realm?

options.label: A
options.text: Through air shafts that drop along the central northern Axis Mundi.
options.rationale: The join is aquatic; the Lands of Mars are an adjacent physical landmass whose ocean basins meet our seas beneath the ice walls.

options.label: B
options.text: Through energetic doors set inside the upper firmament canopy.
options.rationale: The firmament is the upper dome; the Lands of Mars are an adjacent physical landmass beneath the ice walls.

options.label: C
options.text: As an adjacent physical landmass whose basins meet under the ice.
options.rationale: The Lands of Mars are an adjacent physical landmass whose ocean basins interface directly with our localized seas beneath the base of the ice walls.

options.label: D
options.text: As a distant planet reached by rocket flight through outer space.
options.rationale: The Lands of Mars are not a distant planet; they are an adjacent physical landmass whose ocean basins interface directly beneath the ice walls.

questions.hint: Consider what lies past the glacial base and how the waters join.

questions.question: What fluid keeps moving under the ice between connected sectors?

options.label: A
options.text: Melted quartz granite feeding telluric charge into copper veins.
options.rationale: Quartz granite stays in solid veins; petrochemical oil is the shared mechanical lubricant under the ice.

options.label: B
options.text: Coolant drawn from the base of the energetic firmament canopy.
options.rationale: The firmament is the upper canopy; petrochemical oil is the shared mechanical lubricant under the ice.

options.label: C
options.text: Heavy brine pumped between the ocean gates by marine guardians.
options.rationale: The guardians enforce the gates; petrochemical oil is the shared mechanical lubricant circulating under the ice.

options.label: D
options.text: Petrochemical oil moving as the shared mechanical lubricant below.
options.rationale: Petrochemical oil continuously circulates under the ice walls, functioning as the shared mechanical lubricant of the global planetary architecture.

questions.hint: Look at the sub-glacial exchange described with the neighboring lands.

questions.question: How many distinct world environments share the Super-Ocean under the Great Dome?

options.label: A
options.text: The plain holds 33 distinct world environments on one shared continuous ocean.
options.rationale: Thirty-three names an initiate degree; the plain comprises 178 distinct world environments.

options.label: B
options.text: The plain holds 178 distinct world environments on one continuous ocean.
options.rationale: The physical plane under the Great Dome comprises 178 distinct world environments sharing a singular, continuous Super-Ocean.

options.label: C
options.text: The plain holds 3 distinct world environments on one continuous ocean.
options.rationale: Three names the ocean gates; the plain comprises 178 distinct world environments.

options.label: D
options.text: The plain holds 60 distinct world environments on one continuous ocean.
options.rationale: Sixty names the treaty parallel; the plain comprises 178 distinct world environments.

questions.hint: Look for the count of worlds on that multi-realm plain.

questions.question: What happens to human self-understanding when the perimeter is hidden?

options.label: A
options.text: Souls are sent below to walk the subterranean circuitboard after bodily death.
options.rationale: The circuitboard carries telluric currents; hiding the perimeter casts people as insignificant accidental biological entities in a vast vacuum.

options.label: B
options.text: Anakim Giants are blocked from ever entering the localized plane.
options.rationale: The Anakim inhabit outer realms; hiding the perimeter casts people as insignificant accidental biological entities in a vast vacuum.

options.label: C
options.text: Consciousness is pushed to ascend on its own into outer Hyperborea.
options.rationale: Hyperborea lies beyond the wall; hiding the perimeter casts people as insignificant accidental biological entities in a vast vacuum.

options.label: D
options.text: People are cast as insignificant accidental biological entities in a vacuum.
options.rationale: Erasing the container convinces incarnated souls that they are insignificant accidental biological entities in a vast vacuum rather than beings on an engineered physical motherboard.

questions.hint: Look at the strategic note about souls and the vacuum story.

questions.question: Who is named among those allowed to carry the public story of the southern ice?

options.label: A
options.text: Nodal watchers associated with the Dyatlov Pass land portal.
options.rationale: Dyatlov Pass is a land portal; the public story is carried by vetted military personnel and figures such as Sir Ernest Shackleton.

options.label: B
options.text: Yeti stationed at Sedona and assigned to polar narrative duty.
options.rationale: Yeti guard land portals; the public story is carried by figures such as Sir Ernest Shackleton.

options.label: C
options.text: Vetted military personnel and figures such as Sir Ernest Shackleton.
options.rationale: Permitted access is restricted to vetted military personnel and high-ranking initiate networks, such as 33rd-degree Freemasons and Sir Ernest Shackleton.

options.label: D
options.text: Anakim envoys speaking for the high civilization of Great Tartarie.
options.rationale: The Anakim inhabit outer realms; the public story is carried by figures such as Sir Ernest Shackleton.

questions.hint: Look at the sanctioned names beside the high-ranking initiate networks.

questions.question: What underground network carries telluric currents across the planetary grid?

options.label: A
options.text: The military line stationed along the southern treaty parallel.
options.rationale: That line is the legal blockade; telluric currents run through the subterranean organic circuitboard.

options.label: B
options.text: The sub-glacial hydrocarbon channels running under the ice base.
options.rationale: Those channels carry petrochemical oil; telluric currents run through the subterranean organic circuitboard.

options.label: C
options.text: The harvest pattern running across the whole enclosed 3rd-density human farm.
options.rationale: The farm is the density condition inside the wall; telluric currents run through the subterranean organic circuitboard.

options.label: D
options.text: A subterranean organic circuitboard of copper, gold, and quartz granite.
options.rationale: The boundary interfaces with the subterranean organic circuitboard, where natural veins of copper, gold, quartz granite, and crystalline networks carry telluric currents.

questions.hint: Look at the veins named where the boundary meets the ground below.

questions.question: What change of condition does the perimeter mark for the human farm?

options.label: A
options.text: A shift from Hyperborea inward toward a mineral bed under the ice.
options.rationale: Hyperborea is already an outer realm; the perimeter marks the move outward from the inverted 3rd-density human farm.

options.label: B
options.text: A shift from the inverted 3rd-density human farm into higher realms.
options.rationale: The perimeter marks the physical transition zone between the inverted 3rd-density human farm and the outer 4th-density and higher realms.

options.label: C
options.text: A shift from the organic circuitboard out into an artificial vacuum.
options.rationale: The vacuum story is the deception; the perimeter marks the move from the inverted 3rd-density human farm toward 4th-density and higher realms.

options.label: D
options.text: A shift from the firmament canopy down onto the treaty parallel.
options.rationale: The treaty parallel is a legal line; the perimeter marks the move from the inverted 3rd-density human farm into higher realms.

questions.hint: Look at the shift from the enclosed farm toward the outer realms.

questions.question: Which beings live in the outer realms just past the glacial boundary?

options.label: A
options.text: 33rd-degree Freemasons sent out to administer the outer sectors.
options.rationale: Those initiates work inside the containment system; outer realms hold Anakim Giants and other high-density beings.

options.label: B
options.text: Kraken and Megalodons posted along the watery exits of the perimeter.
options.rationale: Those beings guard the ocean gates; outer realms hold Anakim Giants and other high-density beings, including Hyperborea.

options.label: C
options.text: Post-reset human cartographers settled in the lands past the boundary.
options.rationale: Post-reset humans are inside the farm; outer realms hold Anakim Giants and other high-density beings.

options.label: D
options.text: Anakim Giants and other high-density beings living out in Hyperborea.
options.rationale: Beyond the boundary are other high-density beings, and the outer realms include Hyperborea and the lands inhabited by the Anakim Giants.

questions.hint: Look at the high-density peoples named beyond this farm.

questions.question: How does hiding the perimeter shape human transport and logistics?

options.label: A
options.text: Drone fleets are fully withdrawn so civilians cannot map their home cities.
options.rationale: Drones are named as a reason for the lockdown; logistics are artificially funneled into commercial pathways instead of field exploration of outer terrestrial sectors.

options.label: B
options.text: Public aircraft are now ordered to navigate by flat-plane geometry.
options.rationale: Flat-plane geometry belonged to Tartarian navigators; modern logistics are artificially funneled into commercial pathways.

options.label: C
options.text: Logistics are funneled into commercial paths instead of outer exploration.
options.rationale: Human technological development in transportation and long-range logistics is artificially funneled into commercial, controlled pathways rather than field exploration of outer terrestrial sectors.

options.label: D
options.text: Mining tools are steered toward copper and gold veins below.
options.rationale: Copper and gold carry telluric currents; the containment steers long-range logistics away from field exploration of outer terrestrial sectors.

questions.hint: Look at the strategic note on where exploration effort is steered.

questions.question: How does the finite globe story support a scarcity claim about energy?

options.label: A
options.text: By saying the ocean gates consume planetary fluids while ships pass.
options.rationale: The gates are passageways; the scarcity claim treats oil as a depleting fossil fuel rather than an infinite fluid circulating beneath the ice.

options.label: B
options.text: By calling oil a depleting fossil fuel rather than a circulating fluid.
options.rationale: Controllers claim oil is a depleting fossil fuel rather than an infinite fluid circulating beneath the ice wall from outer realms.

options.label: C
options.text: By teaching that the firmament canopy soaks minerals out of the ground.
options.rationale: The firmament is the upper canopy; the scarcity claim treats oil as a depleting fossil fuel rather than a circulating fluid.

options.label: D
options.text: By hiding copper veins and calling them the depleted energy source.
options.rationale: Copper carries telluric currents; the scarcity claim treats oil as a depleting fossil fuel rather than a circulating fluid.

questions.hint: Look at the strategic note on minerals and a fluid from outer realms.

questions.question: How did Tartarian navigators read the shape of this realm?

options.label: A
options.text: They mapped the sub-glacial oil channels with deep sounding gear.
options.rationale: Oil circulates under the ice, but Tartarian navigators utilized flat-plane geometry and direct observation of the enclosed circuit.

options.label: B
options.text: They used flat-plane geometry and direct observation of the circuit.
options.rationale: Tartarian navigators utilized flat-plane geometry and direct observation, recognizing a stable, enclosed circuit rather than a sphere in vacuum.

options.label: C
options.text: They tracked heliocentric orbits that were set against outer-space coordinates.
options.rationale: The heliocentric narrative came after the reset; Tartarian navigators utilized flat-plane geometry and direct observation.

options.label: D
options.text: They applied spherical trigonometry that was tied to satellite positioning.
options.rationale: Sphere-and-space navigation is the later story; Tartarian navigators utilized flat-plane geometry and direct observation.

questions.hint: Think about the geometry they used before the spinning-ball story.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT named as a development that pushed gatekeepers to lock the perimeter?

options.label: A
options.text: Shackleton expeditions that civilians could join toward the boundary.
options.rationale: The lockdown followed cold-weather clothing, amphibious vehicles, and drone technologies, while Sir Ernest Shackleton is named among vetted figures already permitted at the perimeter.

options.label: B
options.text: Cold-weather clothing that civilians could carry toward the boundary.
options.rationale: Cold-weather clothing is named among the developments that made unauthorized expeditions toward the boundary realistic.

options.label: C
options.text: Drone technologies that civilians could fly toward the boundary.
options.rationale: Drone technologies are named among the developments that made unauthorized expeditions toward the boundary realistic.

options.label: D
options.text: Amphibious vehicles that civilians could drive toward the boundary.
options.rationale: Amphibious vehicles are named among the developments that made unauthorized expeditions toward the boundary realistic.

questions.hint: Review what civilian gear made a trip toward the boundary newly practical.

questions.question: True or False: Ancient and Tartarian cartographers marked outer physical zones with descriptions such as Here be Dragons.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Ancient and Tartarian cartographers marked outer physical zones where non-human species resided with descriptions such as Here be Dragons.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Those cartographers did mark outer physical zones where non-human species resided with descriptions such as Here be Dragons.

questions.hint: Look at how older maps treated the outer zones.

questions.question: True or False: Magnetic compass needles continue to align toward the central northern Axis Mundi regardless of proximity to the southern boundary.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Magnetic compass needles continue to align toward the central northern Axis Mundi regardless of proximity to the southern boundary.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The needles do continue to align toward the central northern Axis Mundi near that southern boundary.

questions.hint: Look at the compass note in the account of the southern boundary.

questions.question: True or False: Quartz granite circulates as a liquid lubricant under the ice walls.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Quartz granite sits in solid veins that carry telluric currents, while petrochemical oil is the shared mechanical lubricant.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Natural veins of quartz granite carry telluric currents in the subterranean organic circuitboard, while petrochemical oil is the shared mechanical lubricant under the ice.

questions.hint: Look at the sub-glacial fluids and the materials of the organic circuitboard.

questions.question: True or False: The Antarctic Treaty of 1959 permits independent civilian navigation south of the 60th parallel.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Independent civilian navigation south of the 60th parallel is strictly prohibited under the Antarctic Treaty of 1959.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Independent civilian navigation, private aviation, and unauthorized scientific research south of the 60th parallel are strictly prohibited.

questions.hint: Look at the rules for civilian travel south of the treaty line.
